items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Rose Thomas. How do you spell it? R-O-Y-C-E. T-H-O-M-A-N.

ctx.x: Joseph LaCroix Pierce. Mm-hmm. And they're better known as Didi. But and your what?
Rose Thomas. How do you spell it? R-O-Y-C-E. T-H-O-M-A-N.
Nice to meet you. And what do you play? I play a clarinet. I see. And how old are you? 14. You're 14. Can you fake? Yes, sir. You can fake and read both, huh? Can you read? Yes, sir.
